title: KTC 4K Smart TV (device hongkong, MediaTek), Taiwan, Google TV 14, build UKNV.260626.001.
header:
KTC 4K Smart TV (device hongkong, MediaTek), Taiwan, Google TV 14, build UKNV.260626.001.
Sold white-label with Taiwan telecom VOD apps preinstalled (friDay/ChocoTV/LiTV/myVideo/
Hami/iQIYI) — those are kept here on the owner's request. This list only removes ACR
tracking, Google feedback telemetry, and OEM factory/demo tools.

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/ktc-4k-smart-tv-hongkong/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/ktc-4k-smart-tv-hongkong/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Do NOT disable com.google.android.katniss — it's Google Assistant/voice search; the
remote's mic button and in-app voice search stop working without it.
